translation.name: Biblica® Open Nkanda wu Moyo, Nguizani Yimona ayi Minkunga 2002
translation.englishName: Yombe: Biblica® Open Nkanda wu Moyo, Nguizani Yimona ayi Minkunga 2002 (Bible)

content.text: Ntimꞌama widi wukinda, a Nzambi.
Ndiela yimbila ayi ndiela bula miziki mu muelꞌama woso.
Kotukanu beno ngitala ayi Lila ;
ndiela kotula khiesa buisa.
Ndiela kuzitisa, a Yave, va khatitsika makanda,
ndiela kuyimbidila va khatitsika batu
Bila luzolo luaku luidi lunneni, luidi luzangama viokila diyilu
kikhuikizi kiaku kieti tula nate ku matuti.
Yayusu kuaku, a Nzambi, ku yilu diyilu
ayi bika nkembo aku wuba va ntoto wumvimba ;
Wutuvukisa ayi wutusadisa mu koko kuaku ku lubakala
muingi bobo weti zola bakulu.
Nzambi wutuba tona ku buangu kiandi kinlongo :
“mu ndungunu, ndiela vasa Sikemi
ayi ndiela teza ndimba wu Sikoti.
Minu phuidi Galadi, minu phuidi Manase ;
Efalayimi wawu nkaku wu ntu ama
Yuda nkawꞌama wu kipfumu.
Mowabi diawu dibola diodi ndieti yobidila.
Va yilu Edomi ndiloza zisandale ziama,
ndiela yamikina mu diambu di ndungunu ama mu basi Filisiti.”
Nani wela kundata ku divula dikindusu ngolo e ?
Nani wela kuthuadisa ku Edomi e ?
Keti ngeyo, a Nzambi, ngeyo wutuloza,
ngeyo wunkambu buela totukanga ayi minkangu mi masodi meto e ?
Wutuvana lusadusu va ntuala mbeni
bila lusadusu lu mutu luidi lu phamba.
Va kimosi ayi Nzambi, tuela tunga
ayi wela kosikisa bambeni zieto.
